features: vision 25/50/75/100 percent blocks mean; bridge token mean; language same depths last prompt token, before any answer; Qwen deepstack branch means retained
task: original single-image gloss prompt; full input context recorded
raw_retention: all selected pooled vectors; full bridge token matrices for every stimulus/reference; these are selected activation records, not all neurons of every layer
direction: OLS slope of centered reference bridge mean on reference c, normalized; no human labels. Same definition in both models.
controls: unit brightness direction from non-intervention original images; 3 seeded orthogonal random directions; same norm/dose. Qwen bridge-only intervention leaves DeepStack branches intact.
intervention: 72 images x 2 presentation orders; fixed reference index 27; bridge uniform additive doses -1,-0.5,0,0.5,1 reference-range slope norm; candidate, brightness, random0/1/2 directions; baseline shared
matching: 12 fixed shape-diverse intervention images; start27; same A/B/SAME bisection stop rules max7; candidate +1/-1, random0 +1/-1, baseline; constrained first-token choice, not free generation; distinguish from original acquisition
probe: ridge readouts fitted on original human/physical/model targets; shape and illumination group CV; layers shown separately, no selecting best test layer; random projection for wide representations fitted without labels
scope: exploratory frozen internal-response experiments; localization/readout is not causal evidence; additive intervention measures model sensitivity and may perturb off-manifold features; no proof of human neural mechanism
